title: A live demo on this page
text: Try the app itself on a sample day of Ramadan, with a class competition already running, before you open it for yourself.

title: Leagues for schools and mosques
text: Organisations ranked side by side by the average points of the people taking part, so a small school can beat a large one.

title: Helpers, weekly awards and sign-up sheets
text: Organisers can add teachers and helpers, hand out awards each week, challenge another organisation head to head and gather volunteers for iftar.

title: More for children and families
text: A profile for each child, a night sky that fills with stars, {n:stories} short stories, a sticker chart and a certificate to print.

title: Start here, for new Muslims
text: My first Ramadan in {n:chapters} short chapters, how to pray in {n:praySteps} steps, and {n:terms} words explained in plain language.

title: Prayer times for any city
text: Search for any city in the world, choose from {n:methods} calculation methods and match the timetable of your mosque.

title: Five more languages
text: Indonesian, Malay, Turkish, Persian and Swahili joined, which makes {n:languages} languages in all.
